predeclaration_rule: Conventional terminology and capability-expanded search families, plus the metrics contract, are frozen before any A3 yield difference is computed or interpreted. Post-hoc addition, deletion, or relabelling of families after seeing ΔN_capability is prohibited.

conventional_search_families.label: Neurofeedback product category terminology
conventional_search_families.notes: Category-branded retrieval; contrasts with capability-family NEUROFEEDBACK_TRAINING function wording.

conventional_search_families.label: Consumer or clinical neurodevice category terminology

capability_search_families.label: Attention and vigilance estimation
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain; binds to frozen F6 family ATTENTION_VIGILANCE.

capability_search_families.label: Fatigue or drowsiness detection
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain; binds to frozen F6 family FATIGUE_DROWSINESS.

capability_search_families.label: Cognitive load and workload estimation
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain. F6 merged cognitive/affective into COGNITIVE_AFFECTIVE_STATE; A3 retains separate family IDs for reporting while binding execution substrate to that frozen F6 family.

capability_search_families.label: Affective or stress-state inference
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain. Shares F6 COGNITIVE_AFFECTIVE_STATE execution substrate with COGNITIVE_LOAD_WORKLOAD; family IDs remain distinct for stratified reporting.

capability_search_families.label: Adaptive interfaces
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain; binds to frozen F6 family ADAPTIVE_INTERFACE.

capability_search_families.label: Neurofeedback and cognitive training
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain; binds to frozen F6 family NEUROFEEDBACK_TRAINING.

capability_search_families.label: Behavioral personalization using brain/body-state signals
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain. No dedicated F6 family existed at F6 freeze; attributable personalization recoveries bind to F6 COGNITIVE_AFFECTIVE_STATE / ADAPTIVE_INTERFACE substrates without inventing a post-hoc F6 family.

capability_search_families.label: Neural decoding and device control
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain; binds to frozen F6 family NEURAL_DECODING_CONTROL.

capability_search_families.label: Neural sensing embedded in ordinary form factors
capability_search_families.notes: Preserved A3 capability domain (earbuds, headphones, eyewear, headbands, and similar ordinary form factors); binds to frozen F6 family NONTRADITIONAL_FORM_FACTOR.

metrics_contract.n_conventional_terminology_definition: Cardinality of the set of distinct canonical PRODUCT offering IDs with at least one INCLUDE_RESOLVED capture under conventional_frame_ids (F1-F5), after exact-product deduplication, under the frozen analysis universe and cutoffs.
metrics_contract.n_all_discovery_definition: Cardinality of the set of distinct canonical PRODUCT offering IDs with at least one INCLUDE_RESOLVED capture under all_discovery_frame_ids (F1-F6), after exact-product deduplication, under the same universe and cutoffs.
metrics_contract.delta_n_capability_definition: N_ALL_DISCOVERY minus N_CONVENTIONAL_TERMINOLOGY. Equals the count of exact offering IDs recovered in the capability-expanded arm (F6) that are absent from the conventional terminology arm (F1-F5). Never raw search-hit counts.
metrics_contract.false_positive_rate_definition: Among raw candidates in the capability arm (F6), the share with outcome EXCLUDE (false-positive relative to the frozen product boundary). Reported separately from BORDERLINE/ABSTAIN.
metrics_contract.unresolved_rate_definition: Among raw candidates in the capability arm (F6), the share with outcome UNRESOLVED_IDENTITY.
metrics_contract.duplicate_rate_definition: Among raw candidates in the capability arm (F6), the share that are known-identity duplicates or within-round duplicates (not new exact offerings).
metrics_contract.unique_product_gain_definition: Identical to DELTA_N_CAPABILITY: unique exact-offering gain attributable to adding capability-expanded search to conventional terminology search.

stratification_policy.by_product_class: Report DELTA_N_CAPABILITY and companion rates by enumeration role (INTEGRATED_SYSTEM, COMPONENT_OR_SUBSYSTEM, STANDALONE_SOFTWARE_OR_SERVICE) when each stratum has at least one INCLUDE_RESOLVED offering in N_ALL_DISCOVERY; otherwise mark stratum NOT_DEFENSIBLE and do not invent counts.
stratification_policy.by_jurisdiction: Report DELTA_N_CAPABILITY by capture jurisdiction when each stratum has at least one INCLUDE_RESOLVED offering in N_ALL_DISCOVERY; otherwise mark stratum NOT_DEFENSIBLE.

boundary: A3 capability-first recall preregistration freezes conventional terminology versus capability-expanded search families and the ΔN_capability metrics contract under the A2 analysis universe before yield interpretation. It does not establish global completeness, market share, effectiveness, unseen-population size, commercialization, S2 publication authority, or v4.2 assessment effect. Freeze alone does not compute ΔN_capability or allocate canonical PRODUCT identity.
